checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Use Hero's Mark of the Hero when worked up to access its reserved abilities. Keep another party member responsible for routine healing.

applicability.tradeoff: Worked-up power window versus routine support coverage

checkpoint_advice.locator: Hero Overview > Type and Loose Ability > Mark of the Hero

checkpoint_advice.subject: Champion arena turn reduction
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: For arena turn targets, use Champion's Divide before the strongest attacking ability. If survival fails, trade this burst slot for Paladin or Priest coverage.

applicability.tradeoff: Triple-manpower attack setup versus defensive consistency

checkpoint_advice.locator: Champion Overview > Type and Loose Ability > Divide

checkpoint_advice.subject: Malign Shrine fixed gear
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Collect Sunderbolt Blade and Dark Robe before leaving Malign Shrine. Compare them with compatible users before buying replacements.

applicability.tradeoff: Free finite gear and Heroic Hoarder credit; no universal best wearer is asserted

checkpoint_advice.locator: Weapons > Sunderbolt Blade > Chest in Malign Shrine (Past); Torso > Dark Robe > Chest in Malign Shrine

checkpoint_advice.subject: Ultimate Key free gear
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Before shopping, open Estard Castle's Ultimate-Key chests for Kingsblade, Pallium Regale, and Platinum Shield.

applicability.gate: Ultimate Key and pre-teleportal Estard cleanup
applicability.tradeoff: Free finite upgrades and collection credit versus postponing story progress for cleanup

checkpoint_advice.locator: Awakening the Almighty > Estard Region > Estard Castle basement four chests

checkpoint_advice.subject: Fire route fixed gear
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Collect Sacred Armour from Buccanham Palace and Magma Staff from Burnmount before buying replacements. Compare legal users after both pickups.

applicability.tradeoff: Free finite gear and collection credit; no best wearer is asserted

checkpoint_advice.locator: Torso > Sacred Armour > Chest in Buccanham Palace after Cathedral of Light events; Weapons > Magma Staff > Chest in Burnmount (Present)

checkpoint_advice.subject: Wind route fixed gear
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Collect the Ventus Tower 2F Tempest Shield, Infanticore Heart, and Multipleximus fixed gear. If the earlier Sanctum Tempest Shield was missed, backtrack for that separate free copy.

items.Tempest Shield: Ventus Tower 2F chest; separate earlier Present Sanctum treasure

applicability.tradeoff: Two free shield copies avoid unnecessary purchases; no universal best wearer is asserted

checkpoint_advice.locator: Awakening the Wind Spirit > Ventus Tower and Villa Priores > Level 2 Tempest Shield; Restoring the Wind Spirit > Ventus Tower (Present) > 2F north stairs

checkpoint_advice.subject: Testy Road fixed rewards
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Clear Testy Road for Metal King Goomerang and Golden Tiara before repeating cups solely for faster turn thresholds.

applicability.tradeoff: Guaranteed completion rewards first versus optional turn-optimization repeats

checkpoint_advice.locator: Weapons > Metal King Goomerang > Buccanham Arena Testy Road Reward; Head > Golden Tiara > Buccanham Arena Testy Road Reward

checkpoint_advice.subject: Arena completion rewards
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Prioritize first clears that award unique Hoarder gear; chase stricter turn rewards only after the guaranteed registry items are secured.

applicability.tradeoff: Guaranteed collection progress before optional turn-count optimization

checkpoint_advice.locator: Weapons, Torso, Head, and Accessories > Buccanham Arena reward rows

checkpoint_advice.subject: Gracos
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Lower Gracos's accuracy. Use Fire before Let Loose, then switch to Ice after his weakness changes; keep recovery ready for his random and party-wide attacks.

roles.damage: Fire before Let Loose; Ice after

applicability.tradeoff: Exploit the current weakness rather than repeating one element

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Gracos > Lower Gracos' Accuracy; Use Fire Skills; Use Ice Skills After Let Loose

checkpoint_advice.subject: Gracos V
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Maintain Buff, cure Poison Breath immediately, and use Fire until Let Loose changes the elemental weakness. Avoid a poison-driven attrition fight while Gracos V regenerates.

roles.damage: Fire before Let Loose; reassess weakness after

applicability.tradeoff: Spend turns curing poison to prevent losing the longer attrition race

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Gracos V > Apply Buff to Party; Cure Poison Immediately; Boss Moveset > Let Loose

checkpoint_advice.subject: Hybris
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Open with physical attacks while Magic Barrier raises spell resistance. Stack offensive and defensive buffs, and assign one support to multi-target healing.

applicability.tradeoff: Physical pressure during the barrier versus inefficient spell damage

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Hybris > Use Physical Attacks; Use Support Skills Often; Use Multi-Target Heals

checkpoint_advice.subject: Gasputin
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Bring poison cures, recovery items, and a debuffer. Apply buffs and debuffs before Let Loose seals skills, then use items to heal and revive until skills return.

applicability.tradeoff: Spend inventory space now to survive the skill-seal window

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Gasputin > Watch Out for Status Effects; Stock Up On Healing Items; Bring a Debuffer Support

checkpoint_advice.subject: Cumulus Vex
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Eliminate summoned Sky Fries with group attacks, raise Wind resistance, and keep party HP high against repeated multi-target damage.

applicability.tradeoff: Clear summons before focusing single-target damage on Cumulus Vex

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Cumulus Vex > Prioritize Sky Fry Summons; Increase Wind Resistance; Keep Party Healthy

checkpoint_advice.subject: Togrus Maximus
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Raise party Defence and keep a multi-target healer assigned. After Let Loose raises Togrus Maximus's attack, prioritize party health over extra damage.

applicability.tradeoff: Defensive turns prevent his boosted group attack from overwhelming the party

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Togrus Maximus > Buff Party's Defence; Keep Party Healthy

checkpoint_advice.subject: Orgodemir first fight
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Equip skill-resistance gear, maintain support buffs, and bring two healing-capable characters. Reapply Magic Barrier after disruption removes it.

applicability.tradeoff: Extra recovery coverage versus maximum damage slots

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Orgodemir (First Fight) > Equip Skill Resist Equipment; Boss Information > Orgodemir First Fight Details

checkpoint_advice.subject: Fire Spirit
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Stack Fire resistance and assign a multi-target healer. Heal immediately after Magma or other party-wide Fire attacks.

applicability.tradeoff: Elemental mitigation reduces damage more directly than another offence slot

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Fire Spirit > Increase Fire Resistance; Bring a Multi-Target Healer

checkpoint_advice.subject: Macho Picchu
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Raise party Defence, remove its buffs with Great Leveller or lower its attack, then unload damage while it is immobile after Let Loose.

applicability.tradeoff: Spend setup turns controlling physical damage, then exploit the safe burst window

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Macho Picchu > Buff Party's Defence; Use Great Leveller; Capitalize on Macho Picchu's Immobile State

checkpoint_advice.subject: Orgodemir final fight
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Stack party buffs in phases one and two. Bring Priest for phase-three curse removal and Armamentalist for Magic Barrier against heavy party-wide skill damage.

applicability.fight: Cathedral of Blight four-phase final fight
applicability.tradeoff: Two support roles reduce burst but answer the fight's curse and group-damage mechanics

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Orgodemir (Final Boss) > Stack Multi-Target Buffs; Bring a Priest Character; Bring an Armamentalist Character

checkpoint_advice.subject: The Almighty and Four Spirits
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Defeat Wind and Fire Spirits before the Almighty can absorb them. For repeat Super Seed runs, use party-wide burst only if the setup already clears safely; no level or turn requirement is asserted.

applicability.tradeoff: Remove offensive absorption targets before focusing the Almighty; repeat speed must not replace consistency

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat The Almighty and The Spirits > Defeat Wind and Fire Spirit First; Super Seed Farming Method

checkpoint_advice.subject: The Time Being
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Defeat both Side Winders first with group attacks. Keep multi-target healing and healing items ready if Time Stop disables the healer.

applicability.tradeoff: Optional detour for the finite Heart before Orgodemir versus conserving resources for the mandatory fight

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat The Time Being > Prioritize Side Winders First; Bring a Multi-Target Healer; Boss Information > Fought in Malign Shrine (Past)

checkpoint_advice.subject: Moostapha
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Keep Kabuff active and lower Moostapha's Attack. Its attacks are physical, so spend support turns reducing damage before pushing offence.

applicability.sequence_note: First Nottagen boss; Malign Vine follows later
applicability.tradeoff: Defensive setup costs early damage turns but controls its physical burst

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Moostapha > Use Kabuff; Lower Moostapha's Attack; Boss Information > Fought in Nottagen (Past)

checkpoint_advice.subject: Malign Vine
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Keep Kabuff active and use Boulder Toss for group damage. Focus Malign Vine itself: defeating it ends the battle even if roots remain.

roles.damage: Boulder Toss group damage; focus Malign Vine

applicability.tradeoff: Group damage controls roots, but direct boss damage ends the fight sooner

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Malign Vine > Raise Party's Defence; Use Boulder Toss; Prioritize Malign Vine

checkpoint_advice.subject: Lourgh and Disorder
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Use Magic Barrier and elemental protection against Lourgh and the Barbatos. Prefer magic damage while the Barbatos make physical attacks less accurate; let Kiefer supply automatic damage.

applicability.tradeoff: Lean on Kiefer's automatic damage so the controlled party can prioritize survival

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Lourgh and Disorder > Use Magic Barrier; Use Magic Skills; Kiefer Will Join the Party

checkpoint_advice.subject: The Almighty
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Equip elemental resistance, assign multi-target healing, and carry cures for Sleep and Paralysis. Expect Disruptive Wave to erase buffs.

applicability.tradeoff: Resistance and recovery slots reduce burst but answer repeated group damage and control

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat The Almighty > Watch Out for Status Effects; Equip Elemental Resistant Armor Pieces; Bring an AoE Healing Character; Boss Moveset > Disruptive Wave

checkpoint_advice.subject: Xenlon
checkpoint_advice.advice_text: Stock revival items, stack defensive buffs before Let Loose, and assign one healer plus one buffer. Recover first after its party-wide combo.

applicability.mechanic: Let Loose chains Annihilate, Fire Breath, and Frost Breath
applicability.tradeoff: Two support roles slow damage but improve survival through the burst turn

checkpoint_advice.locator: How to Beat Xenlon > Stock Up on Revive Items; Stack Defensive Buffs; Bring One Healer and One Buffer

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Resolved as a process-stage ambiguity rather than incompatible venues. Three independent current-version walkthroughs agree that the contact event triggers at the Shrine of Mysteries and transports the party to Alltrades Abbey, where Jacqui completes the activation. RPG Site describes the trigger step; Game8 describes the activation step. The Game8 claim is selected only for its activation-location wording; the corroborated sequence claim preserves both stages.

Resolved in favor of Game8's dedicated Alltrades Abbey map shop table, which explicitly lists Iron Shield at 600 Gold in the Past equipment shop. That location-specific, dated inventory row directly answers availability and price; the generic item overview's Buy '-' is treated as incomplete rather than evidence that no shop sells it.

Resolved in favor of RPG Site's Past Hardlypool Tunnel chest route. Game8's dedicated dungeon map independently corroborates that route by listing Ice Shield under Past equipment treasures; the older generic Game8 item page's 'As Treasure: Not Available' is treated as incomplete.
Resolved to Game8's dedicated Hardlypool Tunnel map, which explicitly lists Ice Shield among Past equipment treasures and is more location-specific than the generic item overview.

Resolved to Tunnel to the Abbey: Allblades Arena. Game8's newer dedicated Cautery Sword acquisition page independently names that Past treasure location, corroborating RPG Site's more precise B2 northwest-chest route; the older best-equipment summary's Estard Underground Path label is treated as erroneous.

Resolved in favor of Game8's dedicated current-version Elevating Shoes acquisition page. Its Dropped From Monsters table explicitly identifies Metal King Slime and separately documents Lucky Panel availability, directly disproving the Heroic Hoarder checklist's Lucky Panel-exclusive note. The numeric monster-drop rate and earliest gated encounter remain unknown.

Resolved to the 3F south-balcony route. RPG Site's floor-specific walkthrough is independently corroborated by Raider King's current-version route text and in-game screenshots, which direct the player to exit south from Level 3. Game8's dedicated Beacon page says second level but also reports its Past map as unavailable, so its floor label is treated as erroneous.

Resolved to the 3F south-balcony route shown in Raider King's current-version in-game screenshots and matching route text. RPG Site independently gives the same 3F south-balcony direction; Game8 reports no available Past Beacon map, so its second-level label lacks equivalent map support.

documents.title: Two-guide methodology
documents.body: Use RPG Site as the chronological 100% completion backbone and Game8 as the optimization layer. Keep every claim attributed. Verify disagreements with official or direct in-game evidence. Never silently blend subjective best-build advice into canonical facts.

documents.title: Alltrades Abbey power spike
documents.body: Alltrades is the first major vocation breakpoint. Finish the liberation arc, collect the Thief's Key pickups, review Lucky Panel for early equipment, then establish character-specific Beginner-to-Intermediate vocation routes. Vocations and later Moonlighting are separate unlocks.

documents.title: Vocation prerequisite graph
documents.locator: Vocation list and unlock requirements tables
documents.body: Intermediate prerequisites: Gladiator = Warrior + Martial Artist; Sage = Mage + Priest; Armamentalist = Warrior + Mage; Pirate = Thief + Sailor; Luminary = Dancer + Troubadour + Jester; Paladin = Martial Artist + Priest; Monster Wrangler = Thief + Shepherd. Advanced: Champion = Gladiator + Paladin; Druid = any two of Sage, Pirate, Luminary; Hero = any three of the seven Intermediate vocations.

documents.title: Completion-safe answer contract
documents.body: Before recommending advancement, check open missables, collectibles, fragments, monsters, shops, and one-time choices. Lead with STOP when content can be lost. Then list immediate completion actions, strongest legal setup, optional grind ceiling, and the safe advancement condition.

documents.title: Lucky Panel completion and power role
documents.body: Lucky Panel begins in the Alltrades region and can provide equipment earlier than shops. Several items are exclusive to its versions or chest pools, making it necessary for Heroic Hoarder. Preserve version, rank, chest status, and exclusivity for every normalized reward.

documents.title: Metal enemy farming progression
documents.body: Metal Slime: Roamer Encampment Region and Highendreigh Tower. Liquid Metal Slime: Heavy Metal Hole and The Beacon. Metal King Slime: La Bravoure Region and Hubble Region in the Present. Platinum King Jewel: Yet Another World. Metal enemies appear as additions to normal encounters rather than visible overworld targets.

documents.title: Mini Medal power thresholds
documents.locator: Mini Medal Rewards > All Mini Medal Rewards
documents.body: Notable rewards include Windcheater at 15, Magic Shield at 20, Liquid Metal Slime Heart at 45, Miracle Sword at 55, Metal King Slime Heart at 60, Sage's Stone at 65, Uber Gringham Whip at 90, Metal King Shield at 95, and Metal King Sword at 100.

documents.title: Early equipment optimization examples
documents.locator: Early game equipment recommendations by character
documents.body: Examples from Game8's early build layer include Cautery Sword and Magic Shield for Hero, Snooze Stick for Maribel before the Abbey seal is cleared because item-use effects remain available, and Windcheater for Ruff as an early defensive and drop-rate option. Treat these as checkpoint-scoped recommendations and verify exact acquisition before live advice.

documents.title: High-value Monster Heart roles
documents.locator: Best Monster Hearts ranking and effects
documents.body: Representative specialized effects include critical enhancement (Cyclops, Clawcerer), physical reflection (Cactiball), periodic nullification (Grody Gumdrops), early damage reduction (Zoma), guaranteed first turn (Dragster), and increased Metal encounter odds (Metal King Slime Heart). Ingest every effect and acquisition method before ranking globally.

documents.title: Fixed stat seeds and renewable farms
documents.locator: How to Farm Stat Seeds; All Stat Seeds Increase Rate
documents.body: Stat-seed gains are fixed in Reimagined. Game8 ranks Klepto Clobber as the strongest general seed-farming method, while rare-drop-only seeds require battle completion. The postgame Almighty loop awards a random Super Seed, and Hot Lucky Panel can yield Pretty Betsy with a three-prizes-per-in-game-day limit. Exact enemy acquisition rows still require normalization.
